answer: Beacon-locked commit-reveal admission: each identity commits H = sha256(secret || address) into the basalt registry with a 0.75-unit escrow locked 8 epochs. In epoch N+4 the beacon publishes R, notarized as a marble record, opening a one-epoch jetty window in which commits must reveal to gain voting weight; early or late reveals are void and forfeit escrow, so pre-computed reveals fail. An attacker minting 500 sybils posts 375 units escrow; if fewer than 40 clear the gate it recovers at most 30 units of influence while forfeiting 345, so farming stays unprofitable.
